pob.text: And he said to him, “What is your name?” And he said, “Jacob.”

pob.text: And Israel said[a], “Enough! Joseph my son is still alive. I will go and see him before I die.”

pob.text: So Israel set out with all that belonged to him and came to Beersheba[a], and he offered sacrifices to the God of his father Isaac.
